test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain amount of money becomes thrice in 5 years at compound interest. How many years it will take to become 9 times?
solution:
Let Principal be P

Rate of interest = r%

Number of years (n) = 5

Amount A = 3P

According to the question,

⇒ 3P = P × (1 + r/100)⁵

⇒ (1 + r/100)⁵ = 3 …… (1)

Now,

Principal = P

Rate of interest = r%

Number of years = x

Amount = 9P

According to the question,

⇒ 9P = P × (1 + r/100)x

⇒ (1 + r/100)x = 9

⇒ (1 + r/100)x = 32

⇒ (1 + r/100)x = {(1 + r/100)⁵)2

⇒ (1 + r/100)x = (1 + r/100)¹⁰

⇒ x = 10

∴ In 10 years it will be 9 times
